dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request patch, current run data, recent run history and canonical route identifiers were searched for both station names, website domains, submission paths and the purpose-bound fbi.radio mailbox. No existing 4ZZZ or fbi.radio submission record was found. The primary 4ZZZ Music Department form was stored once; its separate Australian-only Album of the Week form was excluded. The fbi.radio general servicing, premiere and program-direct routes were consolidated into the single officially authorized music@fbiradio.com opportunity to prevent duplicate outreach.
emailVerificationLevel: fbi.radio's official contact and Music Submissions pages both publish music@fbiradio.com for music submissions, and the legacy fbiradio.com web domain redirects to the current fbi.radio website. The address was validated by official publication, syntax, domain relationship and stated purpose. 4ZZZ publicly lists reception@4zzz.org.au for general station contact, but its official Music Submissions page directs artists to the first-party form, so the general mailbox was not queued. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email or form was sent; no track, stream, download, image, press material, metadata, release date, identity information, sensitive demographic field, content warning, permission checkbox, rights declaration, consent or personal data was supplied. No JavaScript-only control, runtime anti-spam mechanism, CAPTCHA, login, authentication, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed. No presenter address was harvested or guessed, and no SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
